non_certification_statement: This retrospective manifest indexes BSD-001 native MATHFORGE source audits through the WP58 exact semistable optimal Manin-constant admission. Detailed source claims and exclusions remain authoritative in the individual audit files; this index does not enlarge them. Protected MATHSOLVE WP56A resolves the height-over-K versus WP00-regulator normalization exactly but retains the Heegner index. The WP57 Forge admission supplies exact period transport and rationality of L(E^D,1)/Omega(E^D) without a rank-zero BSD evaluation. The WP58 Forge admission proves only that the optimal semistable Manin constant is ±1, including at p=2; it does not prove the selected nonoptimal curve's C_f is one or even a 2-unit until downstream isogeny transport is established. It does not determine the twist L-ratio valuation, Heegner primitivity, fixed-p=2 height nondegeneracy, a height-one-(2) analytic determinant theorem, final quadratic descent, BSD-R2-A1, novelty, priority, or MATHCERT certification.
